errors.text_span: Има общо осем категории инвестиции, представени в таблицата в горната част на изображението.
errors.evidence: The top table contains 8 rows of investments, but the figure also shows two pie charts and a metrics table; however the description’s later statement that the left pie chart has eight sectors is incorrect, as the left pie has 5 visible sectors (7TH, EUR_USD, Schroder, Gold, AUD_USD, Other) with ETH_USD and 4ЕН/5PET shown in the separate right pie.

errors.text_span: Първата кръгова диаграма в долната част на изображението визуално представя процентното разпределение на активите в "Портфейл 5", показвайки осем сектора: 7ТН със 41%, EUR_USD с 32%, Schroder с 10%, Gold със 7%, AUD_USD с 4%, ETH_USD с 4%, и "Other" със 6% без конкретна етикет.
errors.evidence: The left pie chart does not show eight sectors. It shows a main pie with 5 labeled slices (7TH 41%, EUR_USD 32%, Schroder 10%, Gold 7%, AUD_USD 4%, Other 6%) and a separate inset pie for ETH_USD, 4ЕН, and 5PET.
The table text reads "Евро/Долар"; the description mixes Latin and Cyrillic incorrectly in the label.

errors.text_span: ETH_USD със 4%, и "Other" със 6% без конкретна етикет.
errors.evidence: The main pie’s slice for ETH_USD is not part of the left pie; ETH_USD appears only in the separate right inset pie. 'Other 6%' is labeled on the main pie, but ETH_USD is not there.

errors.text_span: показвайки осем сектора: 7ТН със 41%, EUR_USD с 32%, Schroder с 10%, Gold със 7%, AUD_USD с 4%, ETH_USD с 4%, и "Other" със 6%
errors.evidence: These percentages are rounded from the figure and are mostly fine, but the mention of 'Schroder' as 10% corresponds to 10.4% in the table; this is acceptable as an approximation, so no major error is needed.

errors.text_span: Няма изрична легенда, но етикетите са директно свързани със съответните секции.
errors.evidence: The figure contains no legend; the labels are placed directly on the pie slices and via leader lines. This is a somewhat interpretive statement but not strongly incorrect.
